{{Quote|Legend says the jewels fell to this planet during the awesome ''cataclysm'' which severed our cluster of the galaxy from the main body and ''created'' the Red Nebula. It is our belief that the gems' ''aura'' protects us from the destructive fate which seemed our ''destiny'' from the time of the cataclysm.|[[Unidentified priest (Red Nebula)|Red Nebula priest]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref>}}
An '''awesome cataclysm''' in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] caused the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]] to start drifting into the further reaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This brought with it the Red Nebula's lone [[Planet of the Red Nebula|inhabited planet]], as well as the [[Unidentified Red Nebula species|species]] that lived on it. The cataclysm brought two gems to the planet, which the species' cadre of [[Priests of the Red Nebula|priests]] dubbed the [[Great Life Jewels]]. It also created a large field of meteors around the world, which created a constant barrage of debris to impact on the world. Only the power of the Great Life Jewels protected the [[Untouched Valley]] and the [[Red Nebula temple|temple]] therein from harm.
